name: Side-by-side installation
focusedTests: isolated application on all four official APK assets
combined application with every current optional patch
install and launch while official com.nuvio.tv remains installed
acceptance: The patch is selected by default in Morphe Manager and can be deselected to retain replacement-install behavior
The output package is com.nuvio.morphe and the launcher label is Nuvio Morphe
The official com.nuvio.tv installation remains installed and launchable beside Nuvio Morphe
Application and component implementation class names remain unchanged
Every app-defined permission declaration and matching request uses the com.nuvio.morphe prefix
Every base and patch-added provider authority uses the com.nuvio.morphe prefix and is unique
A manifest with an unexpected package, permission declaration, or provider authority fails instead of producing a collision-prone APK
No runtime preference, storage path, feature behavior, or Nuvio account data is migrated from com.nuvio.tv
No crash, ANR, VerifyError, provider collision, or fatal log occurs during install or launch
